title: Cauchy–Schwarz inequality for product inner products
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $n$ be a natural number, and let $f,g:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. With respect to the independent product distribution with marginal $\pi$, the square of the product inner product of $f$ and $g$ is at most the product of their second moments:
\[
\langle f,g\rangle^2\leq \mathbb E[f^2]\,\mathbb E[g^2].
\]
